title: Content types matter
summary: A MIME type tells the browser what kind of file it received. Standard Nginx MIME mappings cover common web assets.
introduction: A MIME type tells the browser what kind of file it received. Standard Nginx MIME mappings cover common web assets. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A MIME type tells the browser what kind of file it received. Standard Nginx MIME mappings cover common web assets.
The mappings help return CSS as text/css and JavaScript with a suitable script content type. The include path depends on the installation.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain why a CSS request should not receive text/html.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A wrong content type can stop scripts, styles or WebAssembly from loading.
For more detail later, use this [Nginx further reading](https://nginx.org/en/docs/beginners_guide.html).

seo.title: Nginx: Content types matter
seo.description: Learn about content types matter in Nginx. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
